record.title: TARFILE

record.title: HTTP REDIRECT
record.description: HTTP REDIRECT is a response event and flow identified by a `Location` header and redirect status codes such as 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308. It is recorded in the response history and may cause a subsequent request to the specified destination. HTTP REDIRECT responses can be processed automatically by Requests. In particular, a 302 redirect may send the client from the original host to the root URL; when the redirect targets a different host, credentials must not be included in the redirected request.
